warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery D350 Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: Discovery D350 engines — the AJ300D Ingenium 3.0-litre diesel, fitted across the D5 generation — commonly show timing chain wear over time. This is a well-documented pattern across the Ingenium diesel family, confirmed by specialist consensus and multiple forum sources. We replace the timing chain, tensioners, guides, injector seals, bearings and gaskets as standard on every AJ300D rebuild.

The AJ300D is a mild-hybrid unit, which shares electrical hardware with the Ingenium MHEV system fitted to other Land Rover models. The DC-DC converter has been identified as a failure point on some MHEV variants, though this has not yet been independently confirmed for the Discovery D5 specifically.
